     9	/-!
    10	# Rank-one fibre reduction for the chart colength
    11	
    12	This is the geometric wrapper around `RankOneFibre`: the genuine chart-reading ideal is mapped
    13	to `B/(read s)`, and that image is definitionally `chartIdealColengthModule`.  Thus a pointwise
    14	span statement for the fibre of the ideal immediately gives the desired vanishing of the
    15	colength fibre.  The span statement is allowed to include the zero-fibre case.
    16	-/
    17	
    18	set_option autoImplicit false
    19	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    20	
    21	universe u
    22	
    23	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
    24	open scoped TensorProduct
    25	
    26	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    27	
    28	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    29	
    30	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    31	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
    32	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π] {a : ℕ}
    33	
    34	namespace ThetaGeneratorSeed
    35	
    36	/-- **Pointwise chart-colength fibre vanishing from ideal-fibre span.**  Let `B` be the
    37	pinned-chart section ring, `J` the genuine `B`-ideal generated by the readings of `K`, and
    38	`I = (read s)` for `s ∈ K`.  If every vector of
    39	`κ(p) ⊗[B] J` is a scalar multiple of `1 ⊗ read(s)`, then the image of `J` in `B/I` has
    40	zero `κ(p)`-fibre.  This is the exact single-point input consumed by the `κ(z)` RD-N bridge;
    41	it uses no global base-fibre or flatness inference. -/
    42	theorem subsingleton_chartIdealColengthModule_tensor_residueField_of_ideal_span
    43	    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool)
    44	    (s : relThetaSections C R π a) (hsK : s ∈ K)
    45	    (p : PrimeSpectrum Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b))
    46	    (hspan : ∀ v : p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[
    47	        Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)]
    48	        (chartReadIdeal K b), ∃ c : p.asIdeal.ResidueField,
    49	          c • ((1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[
    50	            Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)]
    51	            (⟨relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s,
    52	              by
    53	                exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨⟨s, hsK⟩, rfl⟩⟩ :
    54	              chartReadIdeal K b)) = v) :
    55	    Subsingleton ((chartIdealColengthModule K b s) ⊗[
    56	      Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
    57	  let B : Type u := Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)
    58	  let I : Ideal B := Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b le_rfl s}
    59	  let P : Submodule B B := chartReadIdeal K b
    60	  let f : B →ₗ[B] (B ⧸ I) := (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ B I).toLinearMap
    61	  have hsP : relThetaResSide a b le_rfl s ∈ P := by
    62	    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨⟨s, hsK⟩, rfl⟩
    63	  have hfs : f (relThetaResSide a b le_rfl s) = 0 := by
    64	    change Ideal.Quotient.mk I (relThetaResSide a b le_rfl s) = 0
    65	    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.subset_span (by simp))
    66	  have hzero := RankOneFibre.subsingleton_map_tensor_of_span_singleton
    67	    P f (relThetaResSide a b le_rfl s) hsP (by
    68	      · intro v
    69	        exact hspan v) (by
    70	      · exact hfs)
    71	  change Subsingleton ((P.map f) ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) at hzero
    72	  exact hzero
    73	
    74	end ThetaGeneratorSeed
    75	
    76	end AlgebraicGeometry

     9	/-!
    10	# The universal divisor rank-one open contract
    11	
    12	The genus divisor representer is unconditional, while the rank-one restriction still needs a
    13	family-level open-locus producer.  This file separates those two facts.  The predicate below is
    14	the inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` along the represented universal Abel map.  A
    15	`DivRankOneOpenData` witness identifies that predicate with the range of one actual open of the
    16	representer; only after that witness is supplied do we define the open subscheme.
    17	
    18	This shape prevents a logical `Subfunctor` from being silently reinterpreted as a scheme.  It also
    19	gives the canonical inverse lane a stable contract: it consumes the witness equality and can use
    20	the resulting open inclusion and all of its pullbacks without choosing a generator.
    21	-/
    22	
    23	set_option autoImplicit false
    24	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    25	
    26	universe u
    27	
    28	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    29	
    30	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    31	
    32	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    33	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    34	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    35	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    36	
    37	noncomputable section
    38	
    39	/-- The universal genus-divisor predicate whose Abel class lies in `PicRankOneOpen`. -/
    40	def divRankOneUniversalPredicate :
    41	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=
    42	  divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi
    43	
    44	/-- Evaluation of the represented genus Abel map on a slice point, with the base morphism
    45	transported from the point in the divisor representer to its source. -/
    46	theorem abelDivAffGenusSigma_app_left_rankOne
    47	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    48	    (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) :
    49	    (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.left) q.left =
    50	      (⟨T.hom,
    51	        (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    52	          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)⟩ :
    53	        (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    54	          (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj (op T.left)) := by
    55	  change (⟨q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom, _⟩ :
    56	      (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    57	        (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj (op T.left)) =
    58	    ⟨T.hom,
    59	      (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    60	        ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)⟩
    61	  refine Over.sigmaExtension_ext
    62	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) q.w ?_
    63	  let e : Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom) ⟶ T :=
    64	    Over.mkCongr q.w
    65	  let q' : Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom) ⟶
    66	      divRepAffGenusScheme C :=
    67	    Over.homMk q.left rfl
    68	  have hq : e ≫ q = q' := by
    69	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    70	    exact Category.id_comp _
    71	  change (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map e.op
    72	      ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    73	        ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)) =
    74	    (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app
    75	      (op (Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom)))
    76	      ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q')
    77	  have hnat := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    78	    ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).naturality e.op)
    79	      ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)
    80	  have hhom :
    81	      (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q' =
    82	        (divFunctorAff C (genus C)).map e.op
    83	          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q) := by
    84	    calc
    85	      (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q' =
    86	          (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv (e ≫ q) := by
    87	            rw [hq]
    88	      _ = (divFunctorAff C (genus C)).map e.op
    89	          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q) :=
    90	        (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv_comp e q
    91	  rw [hhom]
    92	  simpa only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using hnat.symm
    93	
    94	/-- A represented genus divisor lies in the universal predicate exactly when its Abel image
    95	lifts through the single public rank-one Picard locus. -/
    96	theorem divRankOneUniversalPredicate_mem_iff_sigma
    97	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    98	    (x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T) :
    99	    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T ↔
   100	      ∃ v : (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
   101	          (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor).obj (op T.unop.left),
   102	        (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op T.unop.left) v =
   103	          (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) x.left := by
   104	  simp only [divRankOneUniversalPredicate,
   105	    divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter,
   106	    Subfunctor.preimage_obj, Set.mem_preimage]
   107	  let p := (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app T
   108	    ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv x)
   109	  change p ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔ _
   110	  have hleft :
   111	      (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) x.left =
   112	        (⟨T.unop.hom, p⟩ :
   113	          (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
   114	            (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj
   115	              (op T.unop.left)) :=
   116	    abelDivAffGenusSigma_app_left_rankOne x
   117	  constructor
   118	  · intro hp
   119	    refine ⟨⟨T.unop.hom, ⟨p, hp⟩⟩, ?_⟩
   120	    rw [hleft]
   121	    rfl
   122	  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
   123	    rw [hleft] at hv
   124	    dsimp [picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl,
   125	      CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtensionNat] at hv
   126	    rcases v with ⟨a, y⟩
   127	    dsimp at hv
   128	    have hfirst : a = T.unop.hom :=
   129	      congrArg (fun z => z.1) hv
   130	    cases hfirst
   131	    have hinj := Sigma.mk.inj hv
   132	    have heq :
   133	        ConcreteCategory.hom
   134	            ((PicRankOneOpen pi).ι.app
   135	              (op (Over.mk T.unop.hom))) y = p :=
   136	      eq_of_heq hinj.2
   137	    change p ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T
   138	    rw [← heq]
   139	    exact y.property
   140	
   141	/-- The Yoneda map induced by the inclusion of an open of an object in the slice.  Naming this
   142	map is useful to consumers which need the actual factorisation through the open, rather than only
   143	the proposition that a point lies in its range. -/
   144	def openSubfunctorMap (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens) :
   145	    yoneda.obj (Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom)) ⟶ yoneda.obj D :=
   146	  yoneda.map (Over.homMk (U := Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom)) U.ι)
   147	
   148	/-- The subfunctor represented by an open `U` of an object `D` in the slice over `Spec k`.
   149	
   150	Its values are precisely morphisms which factor through the open immersion `U.ι`; using the
   151	Yoneda range keeps this definition independent of any chosen affine presentation of `U`. -/
   152	def openSubfunctor (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens) :
   153	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj D) :=
   154	  Subfunctor.range (openSubfunctorMap D U)
   155	
   156	/-- Unpack range membership into the actual source point and its equality in the ambient Yoneda
   157	functor.  This is the pointwise factorisation API used by inverse constructions. -/
   158	theorem openSubfunctor_mem_iff
   159	    (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens)
   160	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   161	    (x : (yoneda.obj D).obj T) :
   162	    x ∈ (openSubfunctor D U).obj T ↔
   163	      ∃ y : (yoneda.obj (Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom))).obj T,
   164	        (openSubfunctorMap D U).app T y = x := by
   165	  rfl
   166	
   167	/-- An explicit geometric certificate for the universal rank-one predicate.
   168	
   169	The equality is the missing family-level producer/gluing statement: it identifies the logical
   170	preimage with an actual open of the canonical genus representer.  No default or top-open witness
   171	is manufactured here. -/
   172	structure DivRankOneOpenData (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi] where
   173	  carrier : (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left.Opens
   174	  carrier_eq :
   175	    openSubfunctor (divRepAffGenusScheme C) carrier =
   176	      divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi
   177	
   178	/-- Genuine relative openness of the public Picard rank-one locus produces the universal
   179	divisor rank-one open.  The carrier is the open image of the represented pullback of the Abel
   180	map, and the proof below identifies its Yoneda range with the defining predicate. -/
   181	theorem divRankOneOpenData_of_picRankOneOpen_isOpen
   182	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) :
   183	    Nonempty (DivRankOneOpenData pi) := by
   184	  obtain ⟨X, snd, fst, hpb⟩ := h.rep (abelDivAffGenusSigma C)
   185	  letI : IsOpenImmersion snd :=
   186	    h.property (abelDivAffGenusSigma C) fst snd hpb
   187	  let U := snd.opensRange
   188	  refine ⟨⟨U, ?_⟩⟩
   189	  ext T x
   190	  rw [openSubfunctor_mem_iff]
   191	  rw [divRankOneUniversalPredicate_mem_iff_sigma]
   192	  have hpbT := (IsPullback.iff_app.mp hpb) (op T.unop.left)
   193	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff] at hpbT
   194	  constructor
   195	  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
   196	    have hxy : x.left = y.left ≫ U.ι := by
   197	      have hleft := congrArg Over.Hom.left hy
   198	      exact hleft.symm
   199	    have hrange : Set.range x.left.base ⊆ Set.range snd.base := by
   200	      rw [← Scheme.Hom.coe_opensRange snd]
   201	      rintro z ⟨t, rfl⟩
   202	      rw [hxy, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
   203	      change U.ι.base (y.left.base t) ∈ snd.opensRange
   204	      change U.ι.base (y.left.base t) ∈ U
   205	      exact (y.left.base t).property
   206	    let u : T.unop.left ⟶ X :=
   207	      IsOpenImmersion.lift snd x.left hrange
   208	    have hu : u ≫ snd = x.left :=
   209	      IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
   210	    refine ⟨fst.app (op T.unop.left) u, ?_⟩
   211	    have hcomm := congrArg
   212	      (fun f => (ConcreteCategory.hom f) u) hpbT.1
   213	    change (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op T.unop.left)
   214	        (fst.app (op T.unop.left) u) =
   215	      (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) (u ≫ snd) at hcomm
   216	    simpa only [hu] using hcomm
   217	  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
   218	    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := hpbT.2.2 v x.left hv
   219	    change u ≫ snd = x.left at hu₂
   220	    have hrange : Set.range x.left.base ⊆ Set.range U.ι.base := by
   221	      rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
   222	      change Set.range x.left.base ⊆ snd.opensRange
   223	      rw [Scheme.Hom.coe_opensRange]
   224	      rintro z ⟨t, rfl⟩
   225	      refine ⟨u.base t, ?_⟩
   226	      have happ := congrArg (fun f => f.base t) hu₂
   227	      simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using happ
   228	    let V : Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
   229	      Over.mk (U.ι ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom)
   230	    let j : V ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C :=
   231	      Over.homMk (U := V) U.ι
   232	    let e : U.toScheme = V.left := rfl
   233	    let l : T.unop.left ⟶ U.toScheme :=
   234	      IsOpenImmersion.lift U.ι x.left hrange
   235	    let l' : T.unop.left ⟶ V.left := l ≫ eqToHom e
   236	    have he : eqToHom e ≫ j.left = U.ι := by
   237	      subst e
   238	      rfl
   239	    have hl : l' ≫ j.left = x.left := by
   240	      dsimp only [l']
   241	      rw [Category.assoc, he]
   242	      dsimp only [l]
   243	      exact IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
   244	    have hlw : l' ≫ V.hom = T.unop.hom := by
   245	      rw [← j.w, ← Category.assoc, hl]
   246	      exact x.w
   247	    let y : (yoneda.obj V).obj T := Over.homMk l' hlw
   248	    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
   249	    change y ≫ j = x
   250	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
   251	    exact hl

     9	/-!
    10	# The presentation locus for the rank-one Abel map
    11	
    12	`PicRankOneOpen` is the functorial locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer whose pullback to
    13	every affine test admits a tied `PicRankOneLocalPresentation`.  Quantifying after every affine
    14	pullback makes the condition intrinsic on arbitrary test schemes; stability under further
    15	pullback is exactly `picEtMap_comp`.
    16	
    17	The remaining declarations form the corresponding preimages in the widened divisor functor and
    18	in its canonical representing Yoneda functor, together with the restricted Abel transformations.
    19	These are logical subfunctors only.  In particular, this file does not assert that
    20	`PicRankOneOpen` is represented by an open subscheme.  The relative-openness acceptance gate and
    21	the conditional universal-divisor carrier contract are exposed separately in `DivRankOneOpen.lean`.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    30	
    31	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    32	
    33	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    34	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    35	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    36	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    37	
    38	noncomputable section
    39	
    40	/-- The rank-one presentation locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer.
    41	
    42	Membership means that every affine pullback of the input plus class admits a local presentation
    43	tied to that pullback.  This is the correct logical subfunctor underlying the future open Picard
    44	locus; no openness or representability assertion is part of this definition. -/
    45	def PicRankOneOpen :
    46	    Subfunctor (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) where
    47	  obj T := {lam | ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    48	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    49	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    50	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))}
    51	  map {T T'} f lam hlam A _ _ t := by
    52	    let F := picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)
    53	    have e : F.map t.op (F.map f lam) = F.map (t ≫ f.unop).op lam := by
    54	      apply Subtype.ext
    55	      exact (picEtMap_comp C f.unop t lam.1).symm
    56	    rw [e]
    57	    exact hlam A (t ≫ f.unop)
    58	
    59	/-! ## The public membership contract -/
    60	
    61	/-- The exact producer predicate for the rank-one locus.
    62	
    63	This is intentionally lambda-tied and quantifies over every affine pullback.  In particular, it
    64	is stronger than a field-fibre `h⁰ = 1`/`H¹ = 0` statement: a producer must supply the complete
    65	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` structure for the pulled-back class. -/
    66	def PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition
    67	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    68	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) : Prop :=
    69	  ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    70	    (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    71	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    72	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))
    73	
    74	/-- Unfolded membership in `PicRankOneOpen`, with the presentation tied to the pulled-back
    75	Picard class.  Keeping this predicate named is important for producers in later lanes: a
    76	field-level divisor or chart witness is not a substitute for this arbitrary-affine-pullback
    77	contract. -/
    78	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_iff {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    79	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) :
    80	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔
    81	      ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    82	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    83	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    84	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam)) := by
    85	  rfl
    86	
    87	/-- Constructor for the exact lambda-tied arbitrary-affine-pullback presentation contract. -/
    88	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations
    89	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    90	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
    91	    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    92	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    93	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    94	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :
    95	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T :=
    96	  (mem_picRankOneOpen_iff pi lam).mpr h
    97	
    98	/-- Constructor using the named arbitrary-affine producer predicate. -/
    99	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentationCondition
   100	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   101	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   102	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition pi lam) :
   103	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T := by
   104	  exact mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations pi h

   106	/-- The inclusion of the public rank-one locus into its degree-genus ambient functor. -/
   107	def picRankOneOpenIncl :
   108	    (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ) :=
   109	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
   110	
   111	/-- The same inclusion after the slice-to-big-site `Σ` extension.
   112	
   113	`IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` is a property of presheaves on schemes.  The rank-one functor is
   114	defined on the slice over `Spec k`, so the `Σ` extension is the category-correct carrier for the
   115	relative-open gate below. -/
   116	def picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl :
   117	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶
   118	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) :=
   119	  Over.sigmaExtensionNat (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
   120	
   121	/-- Relative openness of the public locus, in Mathlib's presheaf sense.
   122	
   123	This is a named acceptance gate rather than an unproved global assertion.  A future geometric
   124	producer discharges it by supplying the represented open pullbacks; no arbitrary `Subfunctor` is
   125	silently treated as an open subscheme. -/
   126	def PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen : Prop :=
   127	  IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi)
   128	
   129	/-! ## The explicit fibre producer contract -/
   130	
   131	/-- A fibre of the rank-one locus over one test class, presented by an open of that test.
   132	
   133	The `exists_factor` field is tied to the displayed class `g` and to an arbitrary source value `v`.
   134	It is the family-level content needed for relative representability; the open immersion itself
   135	supplies uniqueness of the factor.  Thus this structure cannot be inhabited by an unrelated open
   136	or by a fieldwise dimension statement. -/
   137	structure PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   138	    {X : Scheme.{u}}
   139	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   140	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))) where
   141	  W : X.Opens
   142	  fst : yoneda.obj (W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
   143	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor
   144	  sq : fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g
   145	  exists_factor : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u})
   146	    (v : (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor).obj (Opposite.op S))
   147	    (w : S ⟶ X),
   148	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (Opposite.op S) v =
   149	      g.app (Opposite.op S) w →
   150	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (W : Scheme.{u}),
   151	      fst.app (Opposite.op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ W.ι = w
   152	
   153	namespace PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   154	
   155	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
   156	variable {g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   157	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))}
   158	
   159	/-- The fibre square supplied by `FibrePresented` is a pullback of presheaves. -/
   160	theorem isPullback (D : PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
   161	    IsPullback D.fst (yoneda.map D.W.ι) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g := by
   162	  refine IsPullback.of_forall_isPullback_app fun S => ?_
   163	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff]
   164	  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
   165	  · exact congrArg (fun φ : yoneda.obj (D.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
   166	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) =>
   167	      φ.app S) D.sq
   168	  · rintro u₁ u₂ ⟨-, h₂⟩
   169	    exact (cancel_mono D.W.ι).mp h₂
   170	  · intro v w hvw
   171	    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := D.exists_factor S.unop v w hvw
   172	    exact ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩
   173	
   174	end PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented

   176	/-- An arbitrary-test fibre producer discharges the relative openness gate. -/
   177	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented
   178	    (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
   179	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶

   181	      PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
   182	    PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi := by
   183	  refine MorphismProperty.relative.of_exists ?_
   184	  intro X g
   185	  let d := D X g
   186	  exact ⟨d.W, d.fst, d.W.ι, d.isPullback, inferInstance⟩
   187	
   188	/-- Expose a supplied relative-open certificate without hiding it behind typeclass search. -/
   189	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_certificate

   191	  h

   194	pullback.  This is the exact shape consumed by an eventual chart/fibre producer. -/

   196	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi)

   198	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   199	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)))

   207	/-- Pullback stability of the public rank-one locus, exposed independently of its definition. -/
   208	theorem picRankOneOpen_map_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   209	    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}

   224	open subscheme `DivRankOneOpen`. -/
   225	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff :

   230	representer. -/

   232	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=

   234	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom

   238	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor ⟶

   240	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).fromPreimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))

   243	def rankOneRepresenterRestriction :
   244	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
   245	      (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor :=
   246	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).fromPreimage
   247	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom

   250	def rankOneAbelRepresented :
   251	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
   252	      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=

   256	The stronger canonical inverse still needs the family-level divisor/evaluation producer; this

   258	theorem rankOneAbelRepresented_mem {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}

   261	      (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T :=

     9	/-!
    10	# Rank-one fibre quotients
    11	
    12	If a vector `1 ⊗ s` is nonzero in a one-dimensional fibre `K ⊗[B] M`, then it spans that
    13	fibre.  Consequently, every surjective image of `M` that kills `s` has zero `K`-fibre.
    14	
    15	The mapped-submodule form is tailored to an ideal `J ≤ B`: if the fibre of `J` has rank one,
    16	`s ∈ J` survives in that fibre, and a quotient map kills `s`, then the image of `J` in the
    17	quotient has zero residue-field fibre.  This is purely right exactness of tensor product;
    18	neither flatness nor finite generation over `B` is needed at this step.
    19	-/
    20	
    21	set_option autoImplicit false
    22	
    23	universe u
    24	
    25	open scoped TensorProduct
    26	
    27	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    28	
    29	namespace RankOneFibre
    30	
    31	/-- A surjective image has zero field fibre when every source-fibre vector is a scalar multiple
    32	of `1 ⊗ s`, and the image kills `s`.  The spanning hypothesis also covers the zero-fibre case;
    33	no dimension or nonzero-vector assumption is required. -/
    34	theorem subsingleton_tensor_of_surjective_of_span_singleton
    35	    {B K M N : Type u} [CommRing B] [Field K] [Algebra B K]
    36	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N]
    37	    (f : M →ₗ[B] N) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (s : M)
    38	    (hspan : ∀ v : K ⊗[B] M, ∃ c : K, c • ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B] s) = v)
    39	    (hfs : f s = 0) :
    40	    Subsingleton (N ⊗[B] K) := by
    41	  have hft : Function.Surjective (f.lTensor K) :=
    42	    LinearMap.lTensor_surjective K hf
    43	  have hzero : ∀ v : K ⊗[B] M, (f.lTensor K) v = 0 := by
    44	    intro v
    45	    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hspan v
    46	    rw [← hc, ← TensorProduct.tmul_eq_smul_one_tmul c s,
    47	      LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, hfs]
    48	    simp
    49	  have hsub : Subsingleton (K ⊗[B] N) := by
    50	    refine ⟨fun x y => ?_⟩
    51	    obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := hft x
    52	    obtain ⟨y', rfl⟩ := hft y
    53	    rw [hzero x', hzero y']
    54	  exact (TensorProduct.comm B N K).toEquiv.subsingleton
    55	
    56	/-- A surjective image of a module has zero field fibre if it kills a nonzero vector spanning
    57	the one-dimensional source fibre. -/
    58	theorem subsingleton_tensor_of_surjective_of_finrank_eq_one
    59	    {B K M N : Type u} [CommRing B] [Field K] [Algebra B K]
    60	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N]
    61	    (f : M →ₗ[B] N) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (s : M)
    62	    (hfin : Module.finrank K (K ⊗[B] M) = 1)
    63	    (hs : (1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B] s ≠ 0) (hfs : f s = 0) :
    64	    Subsingleton (N ⊗[B] K) := by
    65	  apply subsingleton_tensor_of_surjective_of_span_singleton f hf s
    66	  · intro v
    67	    exact exists_smul_eq_of_finrank_eq_one hfin hs v
    68	  · exact hfs
    69	
    70	/-- If a linear map kills a generator of a one-dimensional source fibre, the fibre of its
    71	range is zero. -/
    72	theorem subsingleton_range_tensor_of_finrank_eq_one
    73	    {B K M N : Type u} [CommRing B] [Field K] [Algebra B K]
    74	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N]
    75	    (f : M →ₗ[B] N) (s : M)
    76	    (hfin : Module.finrank K (K ⊗[B] M) = 1)
    77	    (hs : (1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B] s ≠ 0) (hfs : f s = 0) :
    78	    Subsingleton ((LinearMap.range f) ⊗[B] K) := by
    79	  apply subsingleton_tensor_of_surjective_of_finrank_eq_one f.rangeRestrict
    80	    (LinearMap.surjective_rangeRestrict f) s hfin hs
    81	  apply Subtype.ext
    82	  exact hfs
    83	
    84	/-- Range specialization of `subsingleton_tensor_of_surjective_of_span_singleton`. -/
    85	theorem subsingleton_range_tensor_of_span_singleton
    86	    {B K M N : Type u} [CommRing B] [Field K] [Algebra B K]
    87	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N]
    88	    (f : M →ₗ[B] N) (s : M)
    89	    (hspan : ∀ v : K ⊗[B] M, ∃ c : K, c • ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B] s) = v)
    90	    (hfs : f s = 0) :
    91	    Subsingleton ((LinearMap.range f) ⊗[B] K) := by
    92	  apply subsingleton_tensor_of_surjective_of_span_singleton f.rangeRestrict
    93	    (LinearMap.surjective_rangeRestrict f) s hspan
    94	  apply Subtype.ext
    95	  exact hfs
    96	
    97	/-- Let `P` be a submodule whose field fibre is one-dimensional.  If `s ∈ P` survives in
    98	that fibre and `f s = 0`, then the fibre of the image `f(P)` is zero.
    99	
   100	For a chart ideal `J` and the quotient map `B → B/(s)`, the conclusion is precisely the
   101	vanishing of the fibre of the image of `J` in `B/(s)`. -/
   102	theorem subsingleton_map_tensor_of_finrank_eq_one
   103	    {B K M N : Type u} [CommRing B] [Field K] [Algebra B K]
   104	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N]
   105	    (P : Submodule B M) (f : M →ₗ[B] N) (s : M) (hsP : s ∈ P)
   106	    (hfin : Module.finrank K (K ⊗[B] P) = 1)
   107	    (hs : (1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B] (⟨s, hsP⟩ : P) ≠ 0) (hfs : f s = 0) :
   108	    Subsingleton ((P.map f) ⊗[B] K) := by
   109	  rw [← LinearMap.range_domRestrict P f]
   110	  apply subsingleton_range_tensor_of_finrank_eq_one
   111	    (f.domRestrict P) (⟨s, hsP⟩ : P) hfin hs
   112	  simpa using hfs
   113	
   114	/-- Mapped-submodule specialization of `subsingleton_tensor_of_surjective_of_span_singleton`.
   115	This is useful when the source ideal fibre may itself be zero. -/
   116	theorem subsingleton_map_tensor_of_span_singleton
   117	    {B K M N : Type u} [CommRing B] [Field K] [Algebra B K]
   118	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N]
   119	    (P : Submodule B M) (f : M →ₗ[B] N) (s : M) (hsP : s ∈ P)
   120	    (hspan : ∀ v : K ⊗[B] P, ∃ c : K,
   121	      c • ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B] (⟨s, hsP⟩ : P)) = v) (hfs : f s = 0) :
   122	    Subsingleton ((P.map f) ⊗[B] K) := by
   123	  rw [← LinearMap.range_domRestrict P f]
   124	  apply subsingleton_range_tensor_of_span_singleton
   125	    (f.domRestrict P) (⟨s, hsP⟩ : P) hspan
   126	  simpa using hfs
   127	
   128	/-- Quotienting by a vector that survives and spans a one-dimensional field fibre produces
   129	a quotient with zero field fibre. -/
   130	theorem subsingleton_quotient_span_tensor_of_finrank_eq_one
   131	    {B K M : Type u} [CommRing B] [Field K] [Algebra B K]
   132	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M]
   133	    (s : M) (hfin : Module.finrank K (K ⊗[B] M) = 1)
   134	    (hs : (1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B] s ≠ 0) :
   135	    Subsingleton ((M ⧸ Submodule.span B ({s} : Set M)) ⊗[B] K) := by
   136	  apply subsingleton_tensor_of_surjective_of_finrank_eq_one
   137	    (Submodule.span B ({s} : Set M)).mkQ
   138	    (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _) s hfin hs
   139	  rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
   140	  exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self s
   141	
   142	end RankOneFibre
   143	
   144	end AlgebraicGeometry

    80	/-- The local equations cut from the tied datum section remain regular after every field-valued
    81	coefficient extension.  This is the regularity input consumed by the widened effectivity
    82	engine, derived from the same fibrewise nonvanishing hypothesis used in the construction. -/
    83	theorem baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_fibrewiseRegular
    84	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    85	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
    86	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
    87	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    88	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
    89	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    90	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
    91	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
    92	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    93	    [Algebra (Localization.Away f) L]
    94	    [IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away f) L]
    95	    (z : relCurve C L) :
    96	    ((relCurve C L).presheaf.germ
    97	      (((P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy).cover.pullback
    98	        (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)).opens z) z
    99	      (((P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy).cover.pullback
   100	        (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)).mem_opens z)).hom
   101	      (Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn
   102	        (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)
   103	        (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy) z) ∈
   104	      nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C L).presheaf.stalk z) := by
   105	  let B := Localization.Away f
   106	  let D := P.datum.baseChange B
   107	  let s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤) :=
   108	    P.datumSectionBaseChange B y
   109	  have hsec : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
   110	      D.sectionsMapTop q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   111	        (P.datumSectionBaseChange B y) ≠ 0 :=
   112	    fun q => P.sectionsMapTop_datumSectionBaseChange_away_ne_zero f y hy q

   114	      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   115	    fun j q => D.injective_rTensor_component_of_sectionsMapTop_ne_zero
   116	      s q (hsec q) j
   117	  unfold baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange
   118	  exact D.germ_self_pullbackEqn_sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular
   119	    s hfib L z

   121	/-- The local equations have the genus class degree after every field-valued extension.  The

   124	theorem baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_classDeg

   132	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
   133	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   134	    [Algebra (Localization.Away f) L]
   135	    [IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away f) L] :

   138	        (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy).picClass) = genus C := by
   139	  letI : Algebra P.cover.Carrier L :=
   140	    ((algebraMap (Localization.Away f) L).comp
   141	      (algebraMap P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f))).toAlgebra
   142	  haveI : IsScalarTower P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f) L :=
   143	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
   144	  haveI : IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier L :=
   145	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
   146	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, RingHom.comp_assoc,
   147	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f),
   148	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k (Localization.Away f) L])
   149	  rw [P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_picClass f y hy,
   150	    P.datum.cechPicClass_baseChange (Localization.Away f),
   151	    ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp,

   153	  exact P.datum_classDeg_baseChange L

   155	/-! ## The local widened divisor and its immediate consumer -/

   159	   a separate contract. -/
   160	theorem existsUnique_unit_tensorAway_rankOne_generators
   161	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   162	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   163	    (y y' : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)

   237	      PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f)).restrictScalars k)
   238	        (PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)

   242	    (Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k

   244	    (Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier B).restrictScalars k

+/-- A generator which is nonzero on every fibre of `D(f)` remains nonzero in every
+residue fibre after extending the whole module to `Localization.Away f`.  This is the
+orientation consumed by the rank-one local-basis theorem. -/
+theorem tensorAwayGenerator_fibre_ne_zero
+    {R Q : Type u} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
+    (f : R) (y : Q)
+    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
+      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
+        Q ⊗[R] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
+    (q : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away f)) :
+    (((1 : Localization.Away f) ⊗ₜ[R] y) ⊗ₜ[Localization.Away f]
+      (1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
+      (Localization.Away f ⊗[R] Q) ⊗[Localization.Away f]
+        q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0 := by
+  have h := TensorProduct.comm (Localization.Away f)
+    q.asIdeal.ResidueField (Localization.Away f ⊗[R] Q) |>.map_ne_zero_iff.mpr
+      (away_one_tmul_one_tmul_ne_zero f y hy q)
+  simpa only [TensorProduct.comm_tmul] using h
+
 /-- Canonical `H⁰` base change preserves the localized pure tensor's nonvanishing. -/
 private theorem h0BaseChange_one_tmul_ne_zero

+/-! ## Degree of the tied datum -/
+
+/- The high-priority `relCurve.instOver` used by the section bridge and the degree stack's
+base-change `Over` instance have the same structure morphism but different instance keys.
+Re-key the standard base-change bundle locally before stating the degree theorem. -/
+noncomputable local instance (priority := 20000) rankOneDegreeOver
+    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
+    (relCurve C L).Over (Spec (.of L)) :=
+  instOverBaseChange C L
+
+noncomputable local instance rankOneDegreeSmooth
+    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
+    SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (.of L)) :=
+  instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C L
+
+noncomputable local instance rankOneDegreeIntegral
+    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
+    IsIntegral (relCurve C L) :=
+  instIsIntegralBaseChange C L
+
+noncomputable local instance rankOneDegreeQuasiCompact
+    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
+    QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (.of L)) :=
+  instQuasiCompactBaseChange C L
+
+noncomputable local instance rankOneDegreeFiniteH0
+    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
+    Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 0) :=
+  instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C L
+
+noncomputable local instance rankOneDegreeFiniteH1
+    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
+    Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 1) :=
+  instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C L
+
+/-- The cocycle datum tied to a genus-degree presentation has class degree `genus C`
+after every field-valued coefficient extension.
+
+The proof follows the presentation itself: restrict `lam` to its etale-cover carrier,
+identify that class with `representative`, rewrite it as the datum's relative Picard class,
+and read the defining degree condition of `lam`. -/
+theorem datum_classDeg_baseChange
+    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
+    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier L]
+    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier L] :
+    classDeg L
+      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
+        P.datum.cechPicClass) = genus C := by
+  let iota : A →ₐ[k] P.cover.Carrier :=
+    (Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k
+  let psi : P.cover.Carrier →ₐ[k] L :=
+    (Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier L).restrictScalars k
+  have hcurve :
+      relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L =
+        (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap psi).left := by
+    refine congrArg
+      (fun f : overSpec k L ⟶ overSpec k P.cover.Carrier => (C ◁ f).left) ?_
+    exact Over.OverMorphism.ext rfl
+  have hpresentation :
+      picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1 =
+        relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
+          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := by
+    exact picEtMap_eq_relPicToPicEt_of_affineRepresentative
+      C lam.1 P.cover P.representative P.represents.symm
+  calc
+    classDeg L
+        (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
+          P.datum.cechPicClass) =
+      relPicDeg L
+        (relPicMk C (overSpec k L)
+          (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
+            P.datum.cechPicClass)) :=
+      (relPicDeg_relPicMk L _).symm
+    _ = relPicDeg L
+        (relPicMap C (Over.overSpecMap psi)
+          (relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
+            P.datum.cechPicClass)) := by
+      rw [relPicMap_mk, ← hcurve]
+      rfl
+    _ = relPicDeg L
+        (relPicMap C (Over.overSpecMap psi)
+          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))) := by
+      rw [P.datum_class]
+    _ = degAt
+        (relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
+          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)))
+        (Over.overSpecMap psi) :=
+      (degAt_relPicToPicEt
+        (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))
+        (Over.overSpecMap psi)).symm
+    _ = degAt (picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1)
+        (Over.overSpecMap psi) := by rw [hpresentation]
+    _ = degAt lam.1 (Over.overSpecMap psi ≫ Over.overSpecMap iota) :=
+      degAt_picEtMap (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1 (Over.overSpecMap psi)
+    _ = genus C := lam.2 L (Over.overSpecMap psi ≫ Over.overSpecMap iota)
+
 end PicRankOneLocalPresentation

     9	import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.ThetaDegree
    10	
    11	/-!
    12	# The translated rank-one cover brick
    13	
    14	This file records the part of the separably-closed cover argument that is already consumable by
    15	the landed fibre API.  A `BaseFieldTranslationDrop` keeps the input class `lambda` in the
    16	presentation equation, chooses its base-field translating class explicitly, and records the
    17	positive-twist/point-subtraction output.  The consumer below turns that output into the exact
    18	`IsSplitWitness` shape used by `chartLocus`.
    19	
    20	The arbitrary-affine family of `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` objects required by
    21	`PicRankOneOpen` is deliberately not inferred from `h0 = 1` and `H1 = 0`: no such producer is
    22	landed in the current API.  The final theorem therefore exposes the field-level consumer and
    23	keeps that family producer as an explicit integration obligation.
    24	-/
    25	
    26	set_option autoImplicit false
    27	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    28	
    29	universe u
    30	
    31	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    32	open TopologicalSpace Opposite
    33	
    34	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    35	
    36	open AlgebraicJacobian
    37	
    38	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    39	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    40	
    41	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    42	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    43	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    44	
    45	noncomputable section
    46	
    47	/-! ## The positive-twist input -/
    48	
    49	section PositiveTwist
    50	
    51	variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Y]
    52	  [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    53	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    54	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    55	  [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    56	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 0)]
    57	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 1)]
    58	
    59	/-- The FLV class theorem in the spelling used by the translated-cover lane.
    60	
    61	The class `l` is the presenting class of the input fibre, while `theta` is the positive
    62	base-field twist.  Keeping this as a named wrapper makes the positive-twist step visible at the
    63	call site; it does not manufacture a presentation or hide the input class in an unrelated
    64	existential. -/
    65	theorem exists_positive_twist_vanishing
    66	    (π : Y ⟶ P1 K) [IsFinite π] [IsDominant π]
    67	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap K = Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    68	    (l θ : Y.CechPic) (hθ : 1 ≤ classDeg K θ) :
    69	    ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ n₀, ∀ W : Y.CurveDivisor,
    70	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K W = l * θ ^ n →
    71	        Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K W) 1) := by
    72	  exact exists_subsingleton_hModule_one_of_one_le_classDeg_of_isFinite_toP1
    73	    π hπ l θ hθ
    74	
    75	end PositiveTwist
    76	
    77	/-! ## The lambda-tied drop package -/
    78	
    79	section DropPackage
    80	
    81	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    82	  [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower k K L]
    83	  [Module.Finite K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
    84	
    85	/-- Data for the positive twist and the subsequent point subtraction.
    86	
    87	`hM₀` ties the splitting field presentation to the particular input `mu`; `hW₀` says that the
    88	divisor being reduced is in the positive twist class (the chart index is zero at this stage).
    89	`baseSubtraction` is intentionally an explicit class-level bridge: it says that the divisor
    90	returned by the greedy reduction is represented by a base-field divisor.  The current tree has
    91	the graph-class version of this bridge but no divisor pullback operation, so this hypothesis is
    92	kept visible rather than replaced by a fieldwise existential. -/
    93	structure SepClosedTranslatedDropData (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K)) where
    94	  m : ℕ
    95	  M₀ : (relCurve C L).CechPic
    96	  hM₀ : PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K μ) =
    97	    PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M₀)
    98	  W₀ : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor
    99	  hW₀ : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W₀ =
   100	    M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   101	      (chartTwistClass C m (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor))
   102	  genusValue : ℕ
   103	  excess : ℕ
   104	  hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (genusValue : ℤ)
   105	  hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W₀ = (genusValue : ℤ) + excess
   106	  h1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   107	    ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W₀) 1)
   108	  P : Set ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   109	  hdense : ∀ U : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).Opens,
   110	    (U : Set ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)).Nonempty → (P ∩ U).Nonempty
   111	  hPcl : ∀ x ∈ P, x ≠ genericPoint ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   112	  hPdeg : ∀ x ∈ P, ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).residueDeg L x = 1
   113	  baseSubtraction : ∀ (S : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor),
   114	    0 ≤ S → Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L S = (excess : ℤ) →
   115	      (∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint _),
   116	        coeffAt hx S ≠ 0 → x ∈ P) →
   117	      ∃ Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor,
   118	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L S =
   119	          Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   120	            ((chartTwistClass C 0 Z)⁻¹)
   121	
   122	/-- The output of the positive-twist/drop construction, tied to both the input class and the
   123	base-field translating divisor.
   124	
   125	The final field is the existing fibre consumer.  In particular, `S` is not merely a divisor
   126	with the right cohomology: `baseClass` identifies its class with the base change of `Z`, and
   127	`translated` is about `mu` translated by the resulting base-field class
   128	`chartTwistClass C d.m Z`. -/
   129	structure SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K))
   130	    (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) μ) where
   131	  S : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor
   132	  Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor
   133	  nonnegative : 0 ≤ S
   134	  degree : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L S = (d.excess : ℤ)
   135	  support : ∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint _),
   136	    coeffAt hx S ≠ 0 → x ∈ d.P
   137	  baseClass : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L S =
   138	    Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) ((chartTwistClass C 0 Z)⁻¹)
   139	  h0_one : Sheaf.h0
   140	    ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L (d.W₀ - S)) = 1
   141	  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   142	    ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L (d.W₀ - S)) 1)
   143	  translated : IsSplitWitness C
   144	    (μ * thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C d.m Z) (overSpec k K))
   145	
   146	/-- Positive twisting followed by point subtraction produces the exact field-level translated
   147	rank-one witness.
   148	
   149	The greedy theorem supplies `S`, `h0 = 1`, and preservation of `H1 = 0`.  The explicit
   150	`baseSubtraction` bridge then supplies the base divisor `Z`; class arithmetic shows that
   151	`W₀ - S` presents `mu` translated by the base-field class `chartTwistClass C d.m Z`.  The last
   152	line applies the existing `IsSplitWitness` consumer, so no unrelated Picard class can satisfy
   153	the conclusion. -/
   154	theorem exists_sepClosedTranslatedDropResult
   155	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K))
   156	    (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) μ) :
   157	    Nonempty (SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) μ d) := by
   158	  obtain ⟨-, S, hS0, hSdeg, hSsupport, hS0one, hS1⟩ :=
   159	    exists_isSplitWitness_of_drop C μ d.m
   160	      (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   161	      d.genusValue d.excess d.hχ d.M₀ d.hM₀ d.W₀ d.hW₀ d.hdeg d.h1
   162	      d.P d.hdense d.hPcl d.hPdeg
   163	  obtain ⟨Z, hSZ⟩ := d.baseSubtraction S hS0 hSdeg hSsupport
   164	  have hW : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L (d.W₀ - S) =
   165	      d.M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   166	        (chartTwistClass C d.m Z) := by
   167	    have hW₀ := d.hW₀
   168	    unfold relCurveMap relCurve at hW₀ hSZ ⊢
   169	    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_add, Scheme.picClass_neg,
   170	      hW₀, hSZ]
   171	    simp only [map_inv, inv_inv]
   172	    rw [mul_assoc, ← map_mul]
   173	    simp only [chartTwistClass, Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_zero, inv_one, mul_one,
   174	      pow_zero, one_mul]
   175	  have htranslated : IsSplitWitness C
   176	      (μ * thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C d.m Z) (overSpec k K)) :=
   177	    isSplitWitness_of_witness_twistClass C μ d.m Z d.M₀ d.hM₀
   178	      (d.W₀ - S) hW hS1
   179	  exact ⟨{
   180	    S := S
   181	    Z := Z
   182	    nonnegative := hS0
   183	    degree := hSdeg
   184	    support := hSsupport
   185	    baseClass := hSZ
   186	    h0_one := hS0one
   187	    h1_vanishing := hS1
   188	    translated := htranslated
   189	  }⟩
   190	
   191	end DropPackage
   192	
   193	end
   194	
   195	end AlgebraicGeometry

     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0SepClosedCover
     8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Curve.MapToP1
     9	
    10	/-!
    11	# The general separably closed translated-cover producer
    12	
    13	This file closes the field-level producer left open by `Pic0SepClosedCover`.  For every field
    14	extension `K/k` and every `mu : picEt C (overSpec k K)`, it constructs the finite separable
    15	splitting field and all of `SepClosedTranslatedDropData`.
    16	
    17	The positive twist stays tied to the presenting class of `mu`.  Its exponent is chosen above
    18	both the FLV threshold and the amount needed to put the twisted class in degree at least the
    19	genus.  The dense-point, residue-one, finite-support, and base-subtraction fields are then filled
    20	by the rational-point-image constructor, so the output feeds the existing translated-drop
    21	consumer without replacing `mu` by an unrelated Picard class.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    26	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    27	
    28	universe u
    29	
    30	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    31	open TopologicalSpace Opposite
    32	
    33	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    34	
    35	open AlgebraicJacobian
    36	
    37	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    38	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    39	
    40	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsSepClosed k]
    41	variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    42	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    43	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    44	
    45	noncomputable section
    46	
    47	section Producer
    48	
    49	variable {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    50	
    51	/-- Every field-valued Picard class admits the complete lambda-tied translated-drop datum.
    52	
    53	The nested existential is the same finite-separable splitting package used by
    54	`exists_splitting_of_picEt`.  In particular, the returned `M₀` is certified by `hM₀` to present
    55	the given `mu`; the positive twist, its representative, and the later base subtraction all live
    56	in that same package. -/
    57	theorem exists_sepClosedTranslatedDropData
    58	    (mu : picEt C (overSpec k K)) :
    59	    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L) (_ : Algebra K L)
    60	        (_ : IsScalarTower k K L) (_ : Module.Finite K L)
    61	        (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K L),
    62	      Nonempty (SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) mu) := by
    63	  obtain ⟨L, hLfield, hkL, hKL, htow, hfin, hsep, M₀, hM₀⟩ :=
    64	    exists_splitting_of_picEt C mu
    65	  letI := hLfield
    66	  letI := hkL
    67	  letI := hKL
    68	  letI := htow
    69	  letI := hfin
    70	  letI := hsep
    71	
    72	  haveI : IsIntegral (relCurve C L) := instIsIntegralBaseChange C L
    73	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
    74	      (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
    75	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C L
    76	  haveI : QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
    77	    instQuasiCompactBaseChange C L
    78	  haveI : Module.Finite L
    79	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 0) :=
    80	    instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C L
    81	  haveI : Module.Finite L
    82	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 1) :=
    83	    instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C L
    84	
    85	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (baseChangeBundle C L).hom :=
    86	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionSndLeft C L
    87	  haveI : IsProper (baseChangeBundle C L).hom :=
    88	    instIsProperSndLeft C L
    89	  haveI : GeometricallyIrreducible (baseChangeBundle C L).hom :=
    90	    instGeometricallyIrreducibleSndLeft C L
    91	  haveI : IsIntegral (baseChangeBundle C L).left :=
    92	    instIsIntegralBaseChange C L
    93	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
    94	      ((baseChangeBundle C L).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
    95	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C L
    96	  haveI : QuasiCompact
    97	      ((baseChangeBundle C L).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
    98	    instQuasiCompactBaseChange C L
    99	  haveI : Module.Finite L
   100	      (Sheaf.HModule ((baseChangeBundle C L).left.moduleKSheaf L) 0) :=
   101	    instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C L
   102	  haveI : Module.Finite L
   103	      (Sheaf.HModule ((baseChangeBundle C L).left.moduleKSheaf L) 1) :=
   104	    instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C L
   105	
   106	  obtain ⟨pi, hpiFinite, hpiDominant, hpi⟩ :=
   107	    exists_isFinite_isDominant_toP1 (C := baseChangeBundle C L)
   108	  letI : IsFinite pi := hpiFinite
   109	  letI : IsDominant pi := hpiDominant
   110	
   111	  let thetaL : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.CechPic :=
   112	    Scheme.CechPic.map ((C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (Algebra.ofId k L)).left)
   113	      (thetaCechClass C)
   114	  have hthetaL : 1 ≤ classDeg L thetaL := by
   115	    dsimp only [thetaL]
   116	    exact one_le_classDeg_cechPicMap_baseFieldTransition_of_one_le
   117	      (C := C) (Algebra.ofId k L) (thetaCechClass C)
   118	      (one_le_classDeg_thetaCechClass (C := C))
   119	
   120	  obtain ⟨n₀, hn₀⟩ :=
   121	    exists_positive_twist_vanishing pi hpi M₀ thetaL hthetaL
   122	  let deficit : ℕ := ((genus C : ℤ) - classDeg L M₀).toNat
   123	  let m : ℕ := n₀ + deficit
   124	  have hn₀m : n₀ ≤ m := by
   125	    simp [m]
   126	  have hdeficitm : deficit ≤ m := by
   127	    simp [m]
   128	  have hdegreeClass : (genus C : ℤ) ≤ classDeg L (M₀ * thetaL ^ m) := by
   129	    rw [classDeg_mul, classDeg_pow]
   130	    have hdeficit :
   131	        (genus C : ℤ) - classDeg L M₀ ≤ (deficit : ℤ) := by
   132	      exact Int.self_le_toNat _
   133	    have hdeficitm' : (deficit : ℤ) ≤ (m : ℤ) := by
   134	      exact_mod_cast hdeficitm
   135	    have hthetaMultiple :
   136	        (m : ℤ) ≤ (m : ℤ) * classDeg L thetaL :=
   137	      le_mul_of_one_le_right (Int.natCast_nonneg m) hthetaL
   138	    linarith
   139	
   140	  obtain ⟨W₀, hW₀raw⟩ := Scheme.CurveDivisor.exists_picClass_eq L
   141	    (M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map
   142	      ((C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (Algebra.ofId k L)).left)
   143	      (chartTwistClass C m
   144	        (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)))
   145	  have hchart :
   146	      Scheme.CechPic.map ((C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (Algebra.ofId k L)).left)
   147	          (chartTwistClass C m
   148	            (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)) =
   149	        thetaL ^ m := by
   150	    simp [thetaL, chartTwistClass]
   151	    exact map_pow (Scheme.CechPic.map
   152	      ((C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (Algebra.ofId k L)).left)) (thetaCechClass C) m
   153	  have hWtheta :
   154	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W₀ = M₀ * thetaL ^ m := by
   155	    rw [hW₀raw, hchart]
   156	  have hdegreeW₀ :
   157	      (genus C : ℤ) ≤ Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W₀ := by
   158	    rw [← classDeg_picClass L W₀, hWtheta]
   159	    exact hdegreeClass
   160	  have h1W₀ : Subsingleton
   161	      (Sheaf.HModule ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W₀) 1) :=
   162	    hn₀ m hn₀m W₀ hWtheta
   163	
   164	  let excess : ℕ :=
   165	    (Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W₀ - (genus C : ℤ)).toNat
   166	  have hexcessNonnegative :
   167	      0 ≤ Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W₀ - (genus C : ℤ) :=

    14	
    15	The full `hfib` discharge chain for a pinned basic-open cocycle datum
    16	`D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π` (`informal/spec-dat-1.md` 1d-ii second half — the
    17	"one open seam" of the W6-full chain, `informal/w4-datum-worksheet.md` §3.1(a)):
    18	
    19	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.subsingleton_h1_tensor_of_baseChange` — **the complex-form

    25	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.presentationSheafIso` — **the presentation bridge** (over a

    27	  presentation `MeromorphicPresentation.ofCocycle` of its canonical subordinated

    72	/-- **The complex-form fibre hypothesis from the fibre datum** (the (1d-ii) second
    73	half): for a `k`-algebra `B'` over the test ring, the vanishing of `H¹` of the
    74	two-lattice pair of the base-changed datum forces the vanishing of the base change of
    75	`H¹` of the pair of the datum: the fibre pair's Čech differential is surjective, the
    76	δ-naturality square (`datumDiffBaseChange`) carries surjectivity to the base-changed
    77	differential, and `H¹(pair) ⊗ B'` is its cokernel by right-exactness. -/
    78	theorem subsingleton_h1_tensor_of_baseChange (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
    79	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B'] [IsScalarTower k B B']
    80	    (h : Subsingleton (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).H1) :
    81	    Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[B] B') := by
    82	  -- the fibre pair's differential is surjective
    83	  have himg : (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).imageLattice = ⊤ :=
    84	    Submodule.Quotient.subsingleton_iff.mp h
    85	  have hsurj' : Function.Surjective (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).diff := by
    86	    rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top, (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).range_diff_eq]
    87	    exact himg
    88	  -- surjectivity transports backward across the δ-naturality square
    89	  have hsq : ∀ a, (D.termBaseChangeInf B').symm ((datumPair (D.baseChange B')).diff a)
    90	      = ((datumPair D).diff.baseChange B') ((D.datumDomBaseChange B').symm a) := by
    91	    intro a
    92	    have hkey := D.datumDiffBaseChange B' ((D.datumDomBaseChange B').symm a)
    93	    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at hkey
    94	    rw [← hkey, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    95	  have hbc : Function.Surjective ((datumPair D).diff.baseChange B') :=
    96	    RigidEngine.surjective_congr _ _ (D.datumDomBaseChange B').symm
    97	      (D.termBaseChangeInf B').symm hsq hsurj'
    98	  -- the base change of `H¹` is the cokernel of the base-changed differential
    99	  rw [(datumPair D).subsingleton_h1_rTensor_iff B']
   100	  exact Submodule.Quotient.subsingleton_iff.mpr (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hbc)

     8	/-!
     9	# A plus class becomes honest over its own étale carrier — over an ARBITRARY affine base
    10	
    11	This closes the obligation the CHART-U(b) header table names "honesty over a general affine
    12	base" (issue I-0558), and it needs no field.
    13	
    14	## The obligation, and why it looked hard
    15	
    16	`Picard/Pic0ChartLocusIsOpen.lean`'s route needs a `BasicOpenCocycleDatum` over an affine base
    17	whose class is the (collapsed) twisted class.  `exists_datum_cechPicClass_chartTwistClass`
    18	(`Picard/Pic0ChartTwistCollapse.lean`) supplies the datum — but it takes an **honest Čech
    19	class** `c` over the base as a *hypothesis*, and a plus class over `Spec A` is not honest: it is
    20	`PicEtAff.mk E x` for an étale cover `E` of `A`.
    21	
    22	The tree's only route from a plus class to an honest one was
    23	`Picard/Pic0ChartSplit.lean`'s `exists_splitting_of_picEt`, which requires `[Field K]` — its
    24	engine is étale field-cofinality (`Algebra.EtaleCover.exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom`),
    25	false over a general base.  So the obligation read as: find a *substitute* for cofinality over
    26	`Spec A`.
    27	
    28	## Why it is in fact free
    29	
    30	There is no substitute needed, because **a cover splits over its own carrier**.  The
    31	field-cofinality theorem is used to produce an `A`-algebra map `E.Carrier →ₐ L` into something
    32	where the class becomes a unit; but the identity `E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier` is already such a
    33	map, and it exists for every cover over every base.  Restricting the plus class along
    34	`A → E.Carrier` therefore makes it honest, with no finiteness, separability, or field
    35	hypothesis anywhere.
    36	
    37	Concretely `PicEtAff.map C E.Carrier (PicEtAff.mk C E x) = PicEtAff.unit C E.Carrier x` — the
    38	transported class is presented by `x` itself.  The proof is the general-base analogue of
    39	`PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_of_algHom` (`Picard/PicEtAffFieldCollapse.lean:79`), which is stated
    40	only for fields; the field hypotheses there are inherited from *its* consumer (the degree seam,
    41	which reads a degree and so needs a field), not required by the argument.  The one substantive
    42	step is the same in both: the descent condition `x.2`, fed to `relPicAlgMap_congr`, identifies
    43	the two ways of transporting `x` to the base-changed carrier.
    44	
    45	## What this does and does not give
    46	
    47	It gives honesty **over `Spec E.Carrier`**, not over `Spec A`.  That is exactly what the
    48	(b-amendment) asks for — its step is "over the étale carrier `B := E.Carrier` the class is
    49	honest", after which the engine fires on `Spec B` and transport (ii) pushes the open locus down
    50	to `Spec A` along the (open, surjective) carrier map.  Nothing here performs that descent; the
    51	topological core of it is landed as `isOpen_of_isOpen_comap_preimage`
    52	(`Picard/Pic0ChartLocusOpen.lean:129`).
    53	
    54	So after this file the CHART-U(b) route has ONE remaining obligation, the pointwise
    55	`IsChartDatumPresentation` — and, unlike the previous "one remaining obligation" claims on this
    56	lane, that one is a genuine statement about matching two fibre predicates, not a missing
    57	construction.
    58

    60	
    61	* `AlgebraicGeometry.PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_self` — **a plus class is honest over its own
    62	  cover carrier**, over an arbitrary affine base.
    63	* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_honest_of_picEtAff` — the existential form.
    64	* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_datum_cechPicClass_twist` — the payoff, in the engine's shape: over
    65	  a base where the class is honest, a datum presenting it twisted by any chart index exists.
    66	-/

   115	theorem PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_self {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]

   118	      = PicEtAff.unit C E.Carrier (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) := by
   119	  rw [PicEtAff.map_mk, PicEtAff.unit_eq_mk C (E.baseChange E.Carrier)]

   122	  exact relPicAlgMap_congr C (E.baseChangeInclude E.Carrier)
   123	    ((Algebra.ofId E.Carrier (E.baseChange E.Carrier).Carrier).restrictScalars A) x.2
   124

   127	/-- **Every plus class over an affine base is honest over some affine base above it** — the
   128	existential form of `PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_self`, which is how a consumer meets it: it does
   129	not get to choose `B`, it gets a `B` from the class's own presentation.

   131	Compare `exists_splitting_of_picEt` (`Picard/Pic0ChartSplit.lean`): that gives a *field*

   136	theorem exists_honest_of_picEtAff {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   137	    (a : PicEtAff C A) :

    11	/-!
    12	# CHART-U(b)'s last residue: the descent direction `hconv`
    13	
    14	`Picard/Pic0ChartPresentationHalf.lean` splits `IsChartDatumPresentation` into a forward half
    15	(proved there, by the trivial splitting) and a converse `hconv`, and its docstring prices the
    16	converse as follows:
    17	
    18	> `hconv` is the descent direction: from a split witness over *some* extension `L_t/κ(t)`
    19	> chosen per point, produce the datum's predicate at `κ(t)` itself.  Its two ingredients both
    20	> exist — `hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension` carries a *datum* predicate across a
    21	> field extension, and `hfib` identifies the classes — but composing them is not a rewrite,
    22	> because the witness received lies in `μ`'s class at `L_t` rather than visibly in `D`'s at
    23	> `κ(t)`.
    24	
    25	**That diagnosis is right, and it names two of the three ingredients.**  The missing one is
    26	the reason the composition is not a rewrite: to see the received witness as lying in `D`'s
    27	fibre class one must go *backwards* through `PicEtAff.unit`, and that step is
    28	`PicEtAff.unit_injective` (`Picard/CechKernelLemma.lean:361`) — the unconditional close of the
    29	ζ3 campaign, Kleiman 2.5(1).  With it the descent is three steps and no geometry:
    30	
    31	1. the split witness at `L_t` gives a presenting class `M` with
    32	   `PicEtAff.map … (picEtAffineEquiv … μ_t) = PicEtAff.unit … (relPicMk … M)` and a witness
    33	   divisor in `M` with vanishing `H¹`;
    34	2. `hfib` at `t`, transported to `L_t`, says the *same* left-hand side equals
    35	   `PicEtAff.unit … (relPicMk … (D's fibre class at L_t))`.  `unit_injective` then makes the
    36	   two `relPicMk` arguments equal, and `relPicMk` is injective too — so `M` **is** `D`'s fibre
    37	   class at `L_t`, which is what "visibly in `D`'s class" was missing;
    38	3. hence `D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing L_t` holds by definition, and
    39	   `hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension` brings it down to `κ(t)`.
    40	
    41	## What this file does and does not close
    42	
    43	It closes `hconv` **from a per-point transported `hfib`** — the statement
    44	`IsChartDatumPlusFibreAt` below, which is `hfib`'s identity read at the chosen extension
    45	rather than at `κ(t)`.  That is a real reduction: `hconv`'s conclusion is a statement about
    46	witnesses and `H¹`, and what remains is a statement about *plus classes only*, with no witness,
    47	no `H¹` and no divisor — exactly the shape §0.3's GAP-6 dictionary cannot see and the shape
    48	`IsChartDatumPlusFibre` already has at `κ(t)`.
    49	
    50	**CORRECTION 2026-07-29 (r7), and this paragraph is why it is worth reading.**  The sentence that
    51	stood here said the transport was not silently assumed because
    52	`isChartDatumPlusFibreAt_of_isScalarTower` was "the honest statement" of it — and **that
    53	declaration did not exist**, in this file or anywhere in the tree.  It was advertised by name and
    54	never written (the failure mode `docstring-declaration-lists-unchecked`), and the effect was worse
    55	than a dangling reference: the sentence made `hplus` read as bookkeeping already discharged, while
    56	`hplus` was in fact the *whole* of B-4's remaining content.  The last clause — "so the composite
    57	needs `hfib` at `κ(t)` and nothing else" — was therefore false of the theorem actually below it,
    58	which takes `hplus` as a hypothesis.
    59	
    60	**It is true now, and of a different theorem.**  `Picard/Pic0ChartPlusFibreTower.lean` proves the
    61	transport (three functoriality laws — `PicEtAff.map_map`, `PicEtAff.map_unit`, `relCurveMap_comp`
    62	— and no geometry) and derives `IsChartDatumPresentation` from `hfib` alone as
    63	`isChartDatumPresentation_of_plusFibre_tower`.  **Prefer that theorem**; the one below remains
    64	correct and is the general form.
    65	
    66	**One further finding, about the statement of `hasWitnessH1Vanishing_of_isSplitWitness_at` below
    67	rather than its proof.**  Its `hplus` binder quantifies `(_ : Algebra A L)` universally with only
    68	the `k`-tower imposed, and that is strictly stronger than the proof consumes: the proof takes the
    69	`A`-structure from its own `htow` and uses `hplus` at *that* instance only.  The extra strength is
    70	not harmless — `IsChartDatumPlusFibreAt` mentions `relCurveMap C A L`, so at an `Algebra A L`

    72	different morphism and `hfib` cannot imply it.  So the `∀`-form is not merely hard to supply, it
    73	is the wrong statement.  `hasWitnessH1Vanishing_of_isSplitWitness_tower` (same file as the

    75	component `towerOfResidueFieldExtension` already returns, and which the proof below already
    76	destructures and then discards.

   116

   118	/-- **The plus-class identity of `IsChartDatumPlusFibre`, read at a given extension `L` of the
   119	residue field** rather than at `κ(t)` itself.
   120	
   121	Witness-free, `H¹`-free and divisor-free, exactly like `IsChartDatumPlusFibre`: it says the
   122	plus class obtained by restricting `μ` to `κ(t)` and then reading it over `L` is the plus-unit
   123	of `D`'s fibre class at `L`.
   124	
   125	This is the form the descent step below consumes, because a split witness for `μ` at `t`
   126	produces its data over an extension it chooses, not over `κ(t)`. -/
   127	def IsChartDatumPlusFibreAt {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   128	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k A)) (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C A π)
   129	    (t : (overSpec k A).left) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   130	    [Algebra (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) L]
   131	    [IsScalarTower k (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) L] [Algebra A L]
   132	    [IsScalarTower k A L] : Prop :=
   133	  PicEtAff.map C L
   134	      (picEtAffineEquiv C (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)
   135	        (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) μ))
   136	    = PicEtAff.unit C L
   137	        (relPicMk C (overSpec k L)
   138	          (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C A L) D.cechPicClass))
   139	
   140	/-! ## The descent step -/
   141	
   142	variable (C π) in
   143	/-- **THE DESCENT STEP** — `hconv` at one point, given the plus-class identity at the
   144	splitting field.
   145	
   146	A split witness for `μ`'s fibre at `t` hands over a finite separable `L/κ(t)`, a presenting
   147	class `M` over `L`, and a divisor `W` in `M` with vanishing `H¹`.  The plus-class identity at
   148	`L` says the *same* left-hand side that `M` presents is the plus-unit of `D`'s fibre class at
   149	`L`.  So:
   150	
   151	* `PicEtAff.unit_injective` (`Picard/CechKernelLemma.lean:361`, Kleiman 2.5(1) — the
   152	  unconditional close of the ζ3 campaign) makes the two `relPicMk` arguments equal;
   153	* `relPicMk` is injective (`relPicMk_injective_of_subsingleton`), so `M` **is** `D`'s fibre
   154	  class at `L`;
   155	* `W` therefore witnesses `D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing L` by definition, and
   156	  `hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension` carries that down to `κ(t)`.
   157	
   158	**This is the ingredient `Pic0ChartPresentationHalf`'s docstring was missing.**  It diagnosed
   159	correctly that "the witness received lies in `μ`'s class at `L_t` rather than visibly in `D`'s
   160	at `κ(t)`", and named the two transport lemmas — but the step that makes the class *visible*
   161	is not a transport at all: it is the injectivity of the plus unit, which the tree has had since
   162	the ζ3 close and which no CHART-U row cites. -/
   163	theorem hasWitnessH1Vanishing_of_isSplitWitness_at {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   164	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k A)) (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C A π)
   165	    (t : (overSpec k A).left)
   166	    (hplus : ∀ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L)
   167	      (_ : Algebra (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) L)
   168	      (_ : IsScalarTower k (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) L)
   169	      (_ : Algebra A L) (_ : IsScalarTower k A L),
   170	      IsChartDatumPlusFibreAt C π μ D t L)
   171	    (htow : ∀ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L)
   172	      (_ : Algebra (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) L)
   173	      (_ : IsScalarTower k (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) L),
   174	      Σ' (_ : Algebra A L) (_ : IsScalarTower k A L),
   175	        IsScalarTower A (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) L)
   176	    (h : IsSplitWitness C (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) μ)) :
   177	    D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) := by
   178	  obtain ⟨L, hLf, hLk, hLK, hLtow, hLfin, hLsep, M, hM, W, hW, hW1⟩ := h
   179	  obtain ⟨hAL, hAtow, hATow⟩ := htow L hLf hLk hLK hLtow
   180	  -- the plus-class identity at `L`, and the presenting identity the witness came with
   181	  have hid : PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M)
   182	      = PicEtAff.unit C L
   183	        (relPicMk C (overSpec k L)
   184	          (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C A L) D.cechPicClass)) := by
   185	    rw [← hM]
   186	    exact hplus L hLf hLk hLK hLtow hAL hAtow
   187	  -- `unit_injective` then `relPicMk` injective: `M` IS `D`'s fibre class at `L`
   188	  have hMcl : M = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C A L) D.cechPicClass :=
   189	    relPicMk_injective_of_subsingleton C (overSpec k L)
   190	      (PicEtAff.unit_injective C L hid)
   191	  -- so `W` witnesses `D`'s predicate at `L`, and the field-extension `iff` descends it
   192	  refine (D.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension
   193	    (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) L).mpr ⟨W, ?_, hW1⟩
   194	  rw [hW, hMcl]
   195	
   196	/-! ## The `htow` hypothesis is satisfiable, checked rather than assumed
   197	
   198	`htow` returns *data* (three instances), so it could in principle be an unmeetable demand and
   199	the descent step vacuous — the failure mode memory `isolating-a-residue-as-a-class` records
   200	from the other direction.  It is not: the composite tower always exists. -/
   201	
   202	/-- **`htow` is constructible**, at any `L` over the residue field.
   203	
   204	The `A`-algebra structure on `L` is the composite `A → κ(t) → L`, where `A → κ(t)` is the
   205	tree's own `Over.instAlgebraTestPointFieldAffine`.  Both towers then hold by
   206	`IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq`.
   207	
   208	Worth stating rather than inlining, because `Algebra A L` does **not** synthesize from the
   209	hypotheses of `hasWitnessH1Vanishing_of_isSplitWitness_at` — measured — so a reader would
   210	otherwise have to guess whether `htow` is a genuine obligation or bookkeeping.  It is
   211	bookkeeping, and this is the proof. -/
   212	def towerOfResidueFieldExtension {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   213	    (t : (overSpec k A).left) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   214	    [Algebra (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) L]
   215	    [IsScalarTower k (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) L] :
   216	    Σ' (_ : Algebra A L) (_ : IsScalarTower k A L),
   217	      IsScalarTower A (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) L := by
   218	  letI : Algebra A L :=
   219	    ((algebraMap (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) L).comp
   220	      (algebraMap A (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t))).toAlgebra
   221	  haveI htow : IsScalarTower A (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) L :=
   222	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl

    89	theorem exists_admissibleAbelDatum_of_affine

   121	        (relPicMk C (overSpec k E.Carrier) c) := by

   125	            (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) :=

    13	(`informal/w4-datc-worksheet.md` GAP-3 Σ-RANK1, §2 (N1)/(N3))

    15	On the fibrewise h¹-vanishing locus, at fibre degree `n` with the base χ-normalization
    16	`χ(𝒪_C) = 1 − n`, the datum engine's `H⁰` is an **invertible** module: finite,
    17	projective, and of stalk-rank exactly `1`.  This is the rank export the engine
    18	(`datumRigidEngine`, `Cohomology/GluedSheafEngine.lean`) leaves open — it delivers
    19	finite + projective, never `rankAtStalk = 1`.

    21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.chi_relCurve` — the χ transport `χ(𝒪_{C_L}) = 1 − n` to every
    22	  field `L` of the test tower (base-field invariance of the genus, `chi_moduleKSheaf`
    23	  + `genus_baseField`; a re-derivation of the private lemma of `DivSchemeMonoBridgeRel`).
    24	* `AlgebraicGeometry.BasicOpenCocycleDatum.h0_sheaf_baseChange_eq_one` — **the fibre
    25	  computation**: for a datum whose fibre class over `L` has `classDeg = n`, with `H¹` of

    27	  `h0_gluedSheaf_eq_classDeg_add_chi` (`n + (1 − n)`) read through the presentation

   109	theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.h0_sheaf_baseChange_eq_one
